_doc: [money] The single source of truth for currencies (core/currencies.gd). The game has exactly three: Cubes (the main money, from bales sold), Parts (robot parts and building stock, from scooped junk, dug-up robot parts and the recycler) and Seeds (planting; the compost press makes them). legacy maps every retired currency id to one of the three at `rate` new units per old unit: GameState.add_currency/get_currency/spend/can_afford accept the old ids (with a push_warning in debug builds) so older code keeps working, and SaveManager's v2 migration converts old saves with the same table. `save` (optional) overrides the rate for save migration only; `into` names a non-currency home for the old balance (compost -> the press hopper).

currencies.name: Cubes
currencies.desc: The main money. Sell bales at the scale. Pays for upgrades, robots, base levels, research, rockets and decorations.

currencies.name: Parts
currencies.desc: Robot parts and building stock salvaged from junk, dug up with the detector, or made by the recycler. Pays for robots and their Mk tiers, base levels, stations, Locker styles, rocket stages and outpost repairs.

currencies.name: Seeds
currencies.desc: For planting. The compost press turns paper, card and spent blooms into seeds.
